name: Keturah
bio: Keturah is the wife Abraham married after Sarah's death, bearing him several sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah (Genesis 25:1-4). While still living, Abraham gave everything he had to Isaac, giving only gifts to the sons of Keturah and his other concubines and sending them away eastward from Isaac, to ensure that the promise would be carried forward through Isaac alone (Genesis 25:5-6).
